title: Paramify - FedRAMP 20x Phase One Pilot Final Submission
author: iteuscher
body:
Paramify has published a 20x Phase One Pilot Final Submission available at:
https://github.com/paramify/fedramp-20x-pilot

Paramify's approach to FedRAMP 20x includes automated evidence collection and assessment by Coalfire as 3PAO. 
The complete machine-readable file from this assessment is available [publicly](https://github.com/paramify/fedramp-20x-pilot/blob/main/machine-readable-package/paramify_coalfire_20x_machine_readable.yaml) on GitHub. 

We look forward to continuing to contribute to the FedRAMP 20x community! 😄
